name: Norm Training
description: Programs, enrolments and completion across the group — who has been trained on what.
purpose: The management surface for staff training: the program catalogue and its module/section/content structure, who is enrolled on which instance (program + variant + venue), and a member × program tracker showing where everyone is. Ported from Orbit, with Norm as the system of record. Also runs performance reviews: review cycles, the manager's side of each review, the review meeting and the goals email.

components.label: Training
components.description: Training programs, plans, the member tracker, sign-offs, people, performance reviews and capability frameworks.

inputs.view: Which tab to open: 'programs' (default), 'plans', 'signoffs', 'tracker', 'people', 'frameworks', or a reviews page: 'my_team_reviews', 'reviews' (every review, HR admins), 'review_cycles' or 'review_emails'.
inputs.program: A training program, by id or name — opens it.
inputs.person: A team member, by id or name — opens their training: programs, progress and plans.
inputs.review: A performance review, by id — opens it (as its manager when that's you).
